title: Math and Physics
statement: A line of n cores (n up to 2·10^5) shrinks to one as cores of mass at least 2 are removed, each split between its neighbours with any part past an end lost; the goal is the largest final mass. Only splitting an end core loses mass, so case analysis gives sum-1 if some interior core has mass at least 2, otherwise sum-(n-1), or -1 if every mass is 1.
